name: Quantization-Aware Fine-Tuning
aliases: Quantization-Aware Training with Layer-wise Non-Uniform Quantization
definition: A fine-tuning step to regain information lost during clustering by optimizing scene parameters at reduced bit-rates using quantization-aware training.
summary: Quantization-Aware Fine-Tuning recovers reconstruction quality lost during vector quantization by simulating low-precision quantization during training to obtain stable gradients, unlike post-training quantization.
